name: sfx_core
description: ScaleFX generic component-server protocol — CoreServer<TServos, TPwms, TLedsDed, TLedsBor, TBattery> dispatches the 0x01..0x7F ComponentPacket range, owns the IDLE/SLAVE/DIRECT lifecycle, keepalive watchdog → safe-state path, async-event emitters (SERVO_TARGET_REACHED, SERVO_MOTION_UPDATE, LED_QUEUE_DONE, PWM_STALL, BATTERY_ALERT), unified status broadcast, and BoardIdentifier persistence. Used by HubFX (master, for its own local components) and expander boards alike. CoreClient (master-side, sfx_core/client/) is the typed CommandResult API + observer chain consumed by HubFX effect orchestrators.
